svg.title: revlens — the main window
svg.desc: Annotated drawing of the revlens viewer: a left rail holding the three view modes and the about page, a header with the document identity, a column with the filter and the revision list, the document itself with every change marked in place, and the inspector on the right showing the revision and the comment behind the selected change. The rail is drawn again at the foot in both of its states, icons only and icons with labels.

g.text: The viewer in apps/web: one bundle, four columns — what is shown, the way in, the document, and the record behind each change.
Interface strings are Czech (apps/web/src/strings.ts) and are drawn here as they appear; the annotations are English, per the repository rule. English drawing: main-window.svg.

g.text: „Sankce v této výši je pro nás
Jedna revize běžně zasáhne víc kapitol.
Jeden pokyn dopadl na víc míst v dokumentu. 1 z 3
The document, its version, and the version this
comparison is made against. Every mark below
The rail — what the window shows
Čistopis — the final text, as the reader gets it.
struck through. Původní verze — the text the
reviewers were given. O nástroji opens #/about.
How many changes have no record behind them,
and when the bundle was built. The count shows
even when it is zero. The header names what is
open; the controls it used to hold are in the rail.
Kapitoly enters by chapter, Revize by the
instruction that caused the change, Připomínky
by the review. The comment list is the only way
to reach a comment that changed nothing.
Full text, author, round, the three gates a
Vypořádání) and a date range. What it excludes
is dimmed in the document, never hidden.
Each revision carries a colour. The same colour
marks every passage that revision produced, in
every chapter. The badges say how its comments
Drag, step with arrow keys, double-click to
The final text with every change marked in
place — no side-by-side diff. Click a mark to
open the inspector; press n to jump to the next
place the same revision landed, chapter or not.
What changed, when and by whom, the verbatim
instruction, the comment with its three gates,
the chapters the revision touched, and its other
edits. A selection is a link that can be mailed.
inserted — underlined, tinted with the revision's colour
excluded by the filter — dimmed, never removed
selected — the edit the inspector is showing
Colour identifies the revision, not the kind of change:
one instruction landing in three chapters is one colour everywhere.
The viewer's whole point is the document, and the editor
webview is routinely half a screen wide: a tool that opens
with two columns of chrome in front of the text has spent
Which state it is in is a per-viewer convenience, remembered
in localStorage under revlens:rail with every access guarded.
Storage that is absent or blocked never stops the page from
rendering — the rail simply opens narrow.
And to a reader who cannot see it
The rail is a nav. The three modes are one group marked
with aria-pressed, because exactly one of them is on at a
time; O nástroji is a toggle, behind a divider.
The label is the accessible name in both states — the narrow
one hides it from the eye and not from a screen reader, so
no entry is ever an unnamed glyph.
The state switch reports aria-expanded, the arrow keys walk
the entries, and the whole rail is hidden in print.
